review_candidates.title: Global Head of Cyber & Resilience
review_candidates.description_excerpt: About the role SustainGRC is governance intelligence infrastructure: one platform and one data model for governance, risk, audit, sustainability, and cyber and resilience, with more than 40 modules already built. We’re looking for a founding-team leader to own our Cyber & Resilience domain: Third-Party Risk Management and Supply Chain Mapping Cyber Controls & Assurance and Continuous Controls Monitoring Vulnerability & Patch Management and Asset Management Cyber and Operational Incident Manageme
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: What we’re looking for Senior experience in cyber risk, operational resilience, third-party risk or business continuity, in financial services or other regulated sectors Hands-on experience implementing or running an enterprise GRC platform An understanding of how cyber governance connects to internal audit, third-party risk and board accountability The credibility to hold a room with a CISO or an audit committee Entrepreneurial appetite: you want to build, not inherit What we offer Founding-team equity A share of practice revenue from day one, with salary introduced as the practice grows A live product and an active, qualified pipeline Real influence over the product roadmap and go-to-market A global, remote role with clients across multiple markets We’ll start with a 30-minute conversation about your experience and the market.
